title: The Quiet Uniform
author: Bram Sterling
blurb: Sebastian Amberdale, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then a child is left at the door with instructions to forget the face — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose which family member gets the last berth, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
